title: AIMA李可胜：香港与内地融合，是加分项还是风险？
speaker: Kersheng Lee

segments.en: There is always that narrative that the China question the Hong Kong is becoming more integrated more like a Chinese city. What what sort of approach or what sort of kind of take do you have on that now?
segments.zh: 总有一种说法，认为香港正与内地更加融合，越来越像一座中国城市。你对此怎么看？

segments.en: Well, I think the the view of our community and we represent fund managers in over 60 countries is that global investors with maybe a few exceptions
segments.zh: 我认为我们行业的观点是——我们代表60多个国家的资管经理——全球投资者，也许有少数例外，

segments.en: Read closer integration with mainland China's excess and that excess is a plus because the gateway role that Hong Kong serves grows more valuable
segments.zh: 认为与内地更紧密融合是加分项，因为香港所扮演的门户角色会变得更有价值。

segments.en: The more connectivity that is involved directions. So we see that you know as a plus and it plays to Hong Kong's strength
segments.zh: 互联互通越深入，我们就越视之为加分项，这正好发挥香港的优势。
